name: Pouākai Crossing
why: Across the northern flank of Taranaki Maunga under the Dieffenbach Cliffs, over the Ahukawakawa swamp to the tarns that mirror the mountain.
book: Free, no permit. One way: book a shuttle (see Venture Taranaki) or leave a car at Mangorei Road. Parking at North Egmont is limited until December 2026 while the new visitor centre is built.
water: Springs between North Egmont and Holly Hut are sacred to iwi: do not wash in them. Huts have rainwater; carry 2 litres.
dangers: Rockfall at Boomerang Slip and other signed zones: cross one at a time without stopping.
Alpine weather changes fast; in winter you need an ice axe, crampons and the skills to use them.
Minarapa Stream before Holly Hut has no bridge and can be impassable after heavy rain.
No cell coverage in places: hire a distress beacon at the visitor centre.
turnaround: At the lookout 10 minutes past the Holly Hut Track junction: if you cannot see the maunga or lack the gear, go back down the Veronica Loop.

points.name: North Taranaki Visitor Centre, North Egmont
points.note: At the end of Egmont Road. The Veronica Loop climbs long steps past the Camphouse and Ambury Monument.

points.name: Holly Hut
points.note: After the Dieffenbach Cliffs and Boomerang Slip, 3-4 h. Te Rere-o-Tahurangi Falls (31 m) is a 1 h return side trip.

points.name: Pouākai tarns
points.note: Small alpine pools on a boardwalk; on a still day they mirror Taranaki Maunga. Keep to the boardwalk.

points.name: Pouākai Hut
points.note: 20 minutes from the tarns, with views up the Taranaki coast. The descent starts here.

points.name: Mangorei Road end
points.note: 2 h down through mossy 'goblin forest' of twisted kāmahi to the Pouākai Crossing car park.
